Nx and Turborepo run tasks across a monorepo, fast, with caching. Flisk runs the services those tasks build, with a database and a gateway.

| | Nx | Turborepo | Flisk |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cached builds and tests | Yes | Yes | No |
| Run every dev server at once | Yes (`nx run-many`) | Yes (`turbo dev`) | Yes (`flisk up`) |
| Wait until a dependency is healthy | No (task order only) | No (task order only) | Yes (`/health` checks) |
| Containers, Postgres and gateway URLs | No | No | Yes |
| Code generators | Yes (generators) | Yes (`turbo gen`) | Yes (`flisk resource`) |
| Works outside a JavaScript monorepo | Partial (plugins) | Partial | Yes |

**Where they are stronger**

- For build speed and CI caching, both are far ahead; Flisk does not cache anything.

**Use them together.** Keep Nx or Turborepo for builds and tests and point each `service.json` `command` at their dev task.

More: [layout.md](../layout.md)
